notes.title: [Patch Note] 0.0.3 Demo version
notes.content: [p]We have improved the overall combat feel and feedback, and the core logic has been updated so that doors remain sealed until a chest is opened when moving between modules.[/p][p]NPC AI and visuals have been updated, and players can now acquire a wider variety of Artifacts. Additionally, acquired Artifacts now have greater visual impact on both the player and their weapon.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Enemy Balancing[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where enemies could not properly climb stairs[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced health and increased summon count for standard NPCs[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted NPC death behavior so that they are thrown farther upon defeat[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Abyss of Yggdrasil[/h3][list][*][p]Map name changed to [b]Wretched Rest[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Foolish Wisp[/b]: Now explodes instantly upon death[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Forgotten Temple[/h3][list][*][p][b]Victorious Loser[/b]: Fixed an issue where the boss would freeze after performing a jump attack[/p][/*][*][p][b]Magnusson the Blasphemer[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the boss would land incorrectly after a ground slam[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the boss failed to properly target players when at a distance[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed other issues causing the boss to remain idle unexpectedly[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Content[/h3][list][*][p]All doors in a module are now sealed upon entry. They can only be opened after unlocking the chest.[/p][/*][*][p]Markers on the minimap, which were previously always visible, are now only activated when the player is within a certain distance.[/p][p](For example, chests will only appear on the minimap once you approach them.)[/p][/*][*][p]Added more diverse Artifacts with unique mechanics, such as lifesteal, health regeneration, and auto-reload.[/p][/*][*][p]Artifact acquisition now applies more visible attachments to the player and their shotgun. Equipping items such as boots or gloves will visually alter the character’s hands and feet.[/p][/*][*][p]The overall layout of the [b]Forgotten Temple[/b] has been adjusted, with a first pass of visual polish applied.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]Wretched Rest[/b] now features a wider variety of dungeon modules.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a twin-cat NPC to the shop (interactions to be added in a future update).[/p][/*][*][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439595/351c12e61eda1c7936df1fd5518b6c035bb916f3.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]General[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Steam Cloud saves could fail[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed locations in certain maps where players could get stuck[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected typos and revised some NPC dialogues[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted friendly fire ratios based on difficulty (including self-inflicted damage)[/p][/*][*][p]Other stability improvements and bug fixes[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: DEVLOG #3
notes.content:
[h3]Hello,[/h3][p]This is the director of《[b]Shell Bless the Faithless.》[/b][/p][p]Following the successful showcase at the Busan Indie Connect (BIC), we’ve been steadily refining the game’s core elements based on the valuable feedback we received. In particular, being selected as a sponsor pick and awarded the [b]“Nicalis Pick”[/b] has given us even greater motivation to push forward.[/p][p]The demo version, which was initially made available only for the online exhibition, will now remain live to gather player feedback continuously.
We will continue to improve the game step by step, and we deeply appreciate your ongoing support.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]GXG 2025 & Indiecraft[/h2][p]On [b]September 19[/b], we will be participating in [b]GXG 2025[/b] as one of the TOP15 finalists of Indiecraft.[/p][p]Having advanced to the TOP15, we have already completed the final round of judging and are currently awaiting the results. We’ll do our best to bring back good news.[/p][p]At the GXG venue, you will be able to play the improved build in person, and those who add the game to their [b]wishlist[/b] will receive a [b]Korotto acrylic figure[/b] as a gift.[/p][p][b]Event Info[/b][/p][list][*][p]Title: GXG 2025 (Game culture X Generation 2025)[/p][/*][*][p]Date: September 19 (Fri) – September 20 (Sat), 2 days[/p][/*][*][p]Location: Pangyo Station area, Seongnam, Gyeonggi Province[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439595/b33d2d27ffe8061dba51992820701e5a3cd68b75.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439595/54587c32f5c59f37495b56c6c5f7bbc524a9ef17.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439595/7c7fb05f66771eee2455a9d7b1e8d11230bfd55a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Improved Demo[/h2][p]An updated demo build has been uploaded, featuring new content along with improvements to bugs, AI, and overall gameplay polish.[/p][list][*][p]New [b]Artifacts[/b] added[/p][/*][*][p]Improved enemy AI[/p][/*][*][p]Features enhancing hit feedback and combat feel[/p][/*][/list][p]For full details, please refer to the [b]patch notes[/b].[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]The demo version will continue to be updated on a regular basis. In addition, we plan to launch a [b]Discord community[/b] soon, providing more direct channels to connect with players.[/p][p]If you encounter any bugs or have suggestions for improvements while playing, please share them with us through the community.[/p][p][b]Your feedback and reviews mean a great deal to us, and they truly keep us moving forward.[/b][/p][p]Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: DEVLOG #2
notes.content:
[h2][b]Greetings from the Director of [i]Shell Bless the Faithless[/i].[/b][/h2][p]Welcome back to our second developer update.[/p][p]It’s been a while since our last devlog—and today, we bring some exciting news we've been quietly preparing behind the scenes.[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]Team Update[/h3][p]Since showcasing our demo at [b]ILLUSTAR PLAY[/b] and [b]PlayX4[/b], we've been hard at work refining and improving key aspects of the game based on your feedback.[/p][p]In addition to developing new content, we focused on refining the shooting action's feel, enhancing AI pathfinding, and significantly improving the overall quality of our art assets.[/p][p]Our team has grown from 6 to 11 members.[/p][p]Thanks to the newly expanded art team, most of the placeholder assets have been replaced, giving our visual direction a much clearer focus. NPC and gear designs that existed only in concept have now entered the implementation stage—and we’re enjoying every moment of it.[/p][p]We also welcomed a new planner who brings a fresh perspective, helping us sharpen the core shooting experience. Our expanded development team is now better equipped to explore bold and experimental gameplay systems.[/p][p]While development has kept us busy, we're thrilled to share that we've been selected as one of the [b]TOP 15 teams at IndieCraft[/b], and are now preparing for the second round of judging. We’re looking forward to another offline showcase where we can engage with players directly and hear your thoughts.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439595/36e1efc3f197175b222e45b7459454ae269900f7.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]BIC Festival 2025 Participation & Limited-Time DEMO Release[/h3][p]We’re excited to announce that [b][i]Shell Bless the Faithless[/i][/b] will officially be showcased at the upcoming [b]\[BIC Festival 2025][/b], held next week in [b]Busan, Korea[/b].[/p][p]In addition, we are releasing a [b]limited-time single-player DEMO[/b], available [b][u]from today until August 31st[/u][/b][u].[/u]
This build offers [b]30 to 40 minutes[/b] of gameplay along a single route and includes the following content:[/p][list][*][p]2 Shotgun Blessings[/p][/*][*][p]2 Stage Themes and a Boss Battle[/p][/*][*][p]Interactive Dungeon Objects[/p][/*][*][p]Destructible Elements and Environmental Hazards[/p][/*][*][p]Basic Dungeon Shop System including Buy, Sell, and Enhence.[/p][/*][*][p]Character Customization[/p][/*][/list][p]Unfortunately, the [b]4-player co-op demo[/b] will not be included just yet—we’ve decided to delay its release slightly to ensure stability and a smoother multiplayer experience.[/p][p]You’ll be able to [b]play the demo firsthand at our booth during BIC[/b], and those who’ve added us to their [b]Steam Wishlist[/b] will receive a small gift at the event. If you’re in Busan this fall, we hope you’ll stop by and say hello.[/p][p]The demo will also be available through the [b]BIC online showcase[/b] and our [b]Steam page[/b]. We would greatly appreciate it if you could share your experiences and impressions—it helps us tremendously.[/p][p]We hope that the essence of what makes a great shooter comes through in this build, and we’re working hard to bring you the multiplayer version soon.[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3867760/Shell_Bless_the_Faithless_Demo/" style="button"]Go to Demo Page[/url][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439595/e762c67bffbbf889b4b223d49a8bf091d9c31ae0.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]Current Development Progress[/h3][p]Our game’s [b]core systems are now firmly in place[/b].[/p][p]We’ve completed the implementation of various interactive dungeon elements such as shops, vending machines, summoning phones, and shrines.[/p][p]The current development focus includes:[/p][list][*][p]Expanding the roster of [b]Shotgun Blessings[/b] and [b]Skills[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Building a [b]narrative and branching system[/b] based on NPC interaction[/p][/*][*][p]Adding [b]new stage themes[/b] and [b]boss encounters[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Polishing enemy AI behavior[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Refining and stabilizing co-op multiplayer[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Our top priorities right now are:
[b]enhancing combat through smarter enemy AI[/b], and [b]implementing unique parts and skill mechanics[/b] that can offer exciting moment-to-moment gameplay.[/p][p]We are also in the process of shaping the [b]out-of-game narrative structure[/b], defining the personality and stories of each NPC to further flesh out the world of [i][b]Shell Bless the Faithless[/b][/i].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439595/9842a673b2fab414a107afdd5bfbb58b4813257c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]Together, Further[/h3][p]With this milestone, we feel development has now stepped into the core phase of building the full game.[/p][p]But to reach wider, deeper, and stranger worlds ahead—we need your support.[/p][p]Please add us to your [b]Steam Wishlist[/b], and stay tuned for more updates.[/p][p]Your interest and feedback mean everything to us.[/p][p][/p][p][b]— Team [i]Shell Bless the Faithless[/i][/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439595/3289a083fe975d66e1fdffc9932b328f53ea6390.png"][/img][/p]

tags.feature: In addition to developing new content, we focused on refining the shooting action's feel, enhancing AI pathfinding, and significantly improving the overall quality of our art assets.
NPC and gear designs that existed only in concept have now entered the implementation stage—and we’re enjoying every moment of it.

We also welcomed a new planner who brings a fresh perspective, helping us sharpen the core shooting experience. Our expanded development team is now better equipped to explore bold and experimental gameplay systems.
In addition, we are releasing a limited-time single-player DEMO, available [b][u]from today until August 31st[/u][/b][u].
This build offers [b]30 to 40 minutes[/b] of gameplay along a single route and includes the following content:
2 Shotgun Blessings
2 Stage Themes and a Boss Battle
Interactive Dungeon Objects
Destructible Elements and Environmental Hazards
Basic Dungeon Shop System including Buy, Sell, and Enhence.
Character Customization
Our game’s [b]core systems are now firmly in place[/b].
We’ve completed the implementation of various interactive dungeon elements such as shops, vending machines, summoning phones, and shrines.
Expanding the roster of [b]Shotgun Blessings[/b] and [b]Skills[/b]
Building a [b]narrative and branching system[/b] based on NPC interaction
Adding [b]new stage themes[/b] and [b]boss encounters[/b]
Polishing enemy AI behavior
Refining and stabilizing co-op multiplayer

Our top priorities right now are:
[b]enhancing combat through smarter enemy AI[/b], and [b]implementing unique parts and skill mechanics[/b] that can offer exciting moment-to-moment gameplay.

We are also in the process of shaping the [b]out-of-game narrative structure[/b], defining the personality and stories of each NPC to further flesh out the world of [i][b]Shell Bless the Faithless[/b][/i].
